notes: An encrypted file, as file.json: enc says how. key is the file key sealed for version version of its folder's key (share-e2ee-v1/file, folder:<folder id>:<version>); header is what its stored bytes start with (contract/crypto/content.json). size is the plain size; /content and the bucket's links give the encrypted bytes, 16 + size + 16 per 64 KiB, as application/octet-stream, and the thumbnail is sealed (application/octet-stream). Encrypted files are in no ZIP and get no thumbnail from the server.
